text: Shared-scale fast path landed in FacetCompiler. With FacetScales.Shared (both dims), mergePositionScales provably returns the global plan unchanged, so the general path's per-panel work was redundant: rows were resolved once globally plus once per panel, position scales trained per panel then discarded, panel ranges scanned then discarded, and identical guide specs computed per panel. resolveSharedPanels now resolves each panel once against its globally-trained slice, derives the global view from the concatenation, and computes registry + axis specs once. General path (resolveFreePanels) unchanged for free scales and kept as test oracle via PlotCompiler.trainFacetedExhaustive / FacetCompiler.trainExhaustive. Receipt medians (M3 Max, JVM 25): facet-grid-30 318->169 ms, 680->359 MB; facet-grid-30-rich 307->158 ms; facet-grid-sparse 171->79 ms (now ~proportional to 15/30 occupied cells); facet-free-scales unchanged ~307 ms. Rendered output verified panel by panel (cell, layout, panel grobs, strip, layer grobs+rows, scene) against the exhaustive oracle in FacetSharedScalesSuite: dense/sparse grids, wrap, lean+rich, 2 contexts; empty declared cells still render panel+strip. Provenance-default item (3): documented in docs/limits.md — rich retention visible in receipt (facet-grid-30-rich retained_rows=48000 vs 0), DSL default unchanged (behavior change deferred; needs owner decision). coreJVM 475 + coreJS 469 tests green; docs/mdoc green. Working tree remains shared/dirty; not committed.
